name: sx/compliance-bar
title: SX Compliance
description: Market-driven responsible gambling notice: age, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion, helpline.

guardrails: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
